description: Renders from props and reports events through callbacks; no data fetching or business state. Easy to preview in every state.
The 2015 pattern for logic: a component that fetches, holds state and renders a presentational child. Replaced by custom hooks.
A `use*` function that owns state, effects and derived data and returns values and actions, without markup.
Pre-hooks ways to share stateful logic by wrapping components; they add tree depth and indirection. Common in legacy code.
Views expose `onQueryChange`, not `setQuery`: the view describes what happened, the owner decides how to store it.
